about: Livingstone, Zambia (id livingstone): the trunk road (OSM way 23591193, ref T1) from Livingstone south past the falls to the old bridge over the gorge of the Zambezi (docs/proge/livingstone.md); draft route, ~4.5 km to the bridge
route: start on the trunk road south of Livingstone, southbound (draft)
near the falls park entrance and the border post
down towards the gorge, east cataract about 100-300 m to the north
finish at the Zambian end of the old bridge (draft; see docs/proge/livingstone.md)
